hero.headline: Co-create your customer’s next growth product line
hero.subheadline: pitchpro is an overseas brand new-category growth platform for factories and trading companies. Starting from brand needs, the AI workbench runs Brief → Design → Assets → Follow-up—turning design, R&D, and flexible supply-chain strengths into brand-ready proposals you can send out.

features.title: One continuous co-creation path
features.description: Chat to advance; results grow on the side. Capabilities stay behind the scenes—the UI always follows Brief · Design · Assets · Follow-up.

brief.title: Brief
brief.description: Upload factory materials, paste a brand site, or set country + category and pick from light search cards. The agent builds capability profiles, brand portraits, opportunity notes, and a design brief—clearly marking confirmed facts, inferences, and items to verify.

design.title: Design
design.description: Explore look, color, materials, and scenes from the confirmed brief. Lock a visual direction for later assets; structure, process, and manufacturability stay with the factory to confirm.

assets.title: Assets
assets.description: Generate concept art, product proposals, detail pages, video, and outreach copy from the same locked direction. When the core brief changes, related assets are marked for update.

followup.title: Follow-up
followup.description: After review, sync contacts, proposals, and copy to GoHighLevel for outreach and nurture. Replies and opportunity signals return to the same brand project to drive sampling and deals.

brands.title: Light brand search + private shelf
brands.description: In-chat public search returns structured brand cards (tone, hero image, site/social). Open a project or save to your private shelf—no heavy platform encyclopedia or weekly seed crawls.

knowledge.title: Enterprise library
knowledge.description: Store design cases, processes, and supply-chain capability across projects. Supply lives in the library; target brands enter via link or light search—co-creation always starts from brand needs.

pricing.title: Plans
pricing.description: For factory and trading teams from pilot to scale (commercial terms via sales).
pricing.starter_desc: Run the first co-creation loop with a small team
pricing.pro_desc: More projects, brands, and generation capacity
pricing.enterprise_desc: Deep research, engineering review, and marketing setup add-ons

faq.title: FAQ
faq.description: A few things to know before you start co-creating.

who.question: Who uses pitchpro, and who is the co-creation partner?
who.answer: Paying users are factories, trading companies, and their sales teams. Co-creation and order partners are overseas emerging and growth brands. pitchpro helps factories become new-category growth partners for those brands.

loop.question: What do the four steps cover?
loop.answer: Brief: understand capability and brand needs, confirm positioning and design brief. Design: explore and lock visual direction. Assets: produce concept art, proposals, detail pages, video, and outreach from one source. Follow-up: sync to GoHighLevel and iterate from feedback.

brands.question: Where do brands come from—is this an encyclopedia?
brands.answer: No. Brands enter via in-chat light search cards plus a private shelf, or by pasting a site/social link. There is no heavy platform seed database or industry-wide weekly crawl.

ai.question: Does AI replace engineering and sampling?
ai.answer: No. pitchpro separates confirmed facts, inferences, and items to verify. Concept design does not replace engineering drawings, sample tests, or market validation—factories confirm structure, performance, and manufacturability.

value.question: How is this different from catalogs and quotes?
value.answer: Outreach starts earlier—at brand research and new-category co-creation. Teams bring grounded concepts, designs, and scene assets to discuss the brand’s next growth line, moving from supplier intros to concrete collaboration.

cta.headline: From supplier intro to new-category co-creation
cta.subheadline: With one enterprise pack and one target brand, run Brief → Design → Assets → Follow-up. Co-create your customer’s next growth product line.
